pages.title: About RORC
pages.text: About RORC RORC Login Menu Close Home About Memberships Rentals Sponsors Projects News & Updates Events Support Privacy Policy Terms of Service About RORC The Story of the Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center How a locked gym in the middle of Bly, Oregon became a community-owned recreation center — and the people who made it happen. The Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center sits in the middle of Bly, Oregon. For many years it was known simply as the Gearhart Gym, a place where people played ball, gathered for events, and spent time together. Its history is tied closely to the town, and the effort to bring it back shows what a small community can do when people care enough to try. A Gym's Silent Years For almost five years the building sat locked and unused. The gym had once been part of the Klamath County School District, originally deeded to the district by the Edsall family more than 85 years ago. Declining enrollment and the cost of upkeep eventually led to its closure in 2012. The original deed included a clause saying that if the property went unused for two years, it would return to the Edsall family. The family did not want it back, but the clause created a legal situation that made transferring the property difficult. During this time the building continued to decline. The roof leaked, plumbing failed, and windows broke. Many people assumed the gym was finished and that nothing more would come of it. The Legislation That Changed Everything In 2015 Senate Bill 953 was signed into law, giving the school district a way to clear the title and transfer the building. This opened the first real opportunity in years for the gym to be used again. The Bly Community Action Team, a local nonprofit that supports community projects, recognized that the building could possibly be saved if people were willing to work together. A Teenager's Determination Around this time, 15-year-old Quentin Nichols posted online about the gym's condition. The post was simple, but it brought attention back to a building many people had almost forgotten about. It encouraged a conversation in town about whether the gym was worth trying to save. A community meeting followed, giving residents a chance to talk through ideas and concerns. This effort caught the attention of Leda Hunter, the president of BLY CAT, who saw potential in bringing the gym back into use. Working with Quentin and other members of the group, including Donna Kness and Chrissy Holgate, the team began putting together information and looking at what would be needed to restore the building. Leda's experience with grants and project coordination helped the group create a clear plan to present to the Klamath County School Board. On July 21, 2016, Leda and Quentin presented the proposal.

pages.title: About RORC
pages.text: The board voted unanimously to transfer the gym to BLY CAT, giving the community the chance to start bringing it back. Leading a Community Revival At 15 years old, Quentin helped spark the push to bring the gym back. The restoration became a community effort, with many people stepping in and contributing in different ways. Restoration and Community Work As restoration began, progress came together through steady effort. A new roof was installed to stop further water damage. Plumbing was repaired and updated with help from local businesses that donated fixtures and labor. A modern heating system was added, making the building usable year round. Energy efficient lighting was installed to brighten the interior and bring the gym back into regular use. Members of the Bly Community Action Team supported the coordination that kept the project moving. Volunteers cleaned, repaired, painted, and restored the building piece by piece. Donations of time, materials, and funds made each improvement possible. Quentin's involvement fit into this wider effort and was shaped by the commitment of everyone who contributed. Why the Facility Is Named After Ruth Obenchain Ruth Obenchain (1912–2002) was a longtime Bly educator, ranch wife, and community leader whose life became deeply intertwined with the town and its people. After marrying into the historic Obenchain ranching family, Ruth helped raise her family near Bly while dedicating nearly four decades to teaching local students. She taught multiple grade levels and served as a principal, becoming known as a firm but caring teacher who shaped generations of Bly’s youth. Beyond the classroom, Ruth was actively involved in community life, local history, church activities, and youth programs. She believed strongly in education, community connection, and preserving Bly’s heritage. The Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center was named in her honor to recognize her lifelong service to the community and her lasting impact on the people of Bly. Today the center continues the spirit of her work by serving as a place where the community gathers for events, recreation, and connection. To learn more about Ruth Obenchain’s life and legacy, read the full article . A Legacy for Future Generations Today the Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center serves many roles for the town of Bly. It offers membership access to the weight room and gym, provides space for community events such as celebrations, weddings, funerals, and reunions, and can serve as an emergency shelter when needed. Its revival stands as a clear example of what steady work and shared commitment can accomplish in a small community. Join the Journey The Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center continues to grow with the help of donors, volunteers, and members.

Introduction This contract is entered into by and between the Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center, operated under the nonprofit Bly Community Action Team, located at 19140 Edler Street, hereinafter referred to as "the Center," and the undersigned member or renter, hereinafter referred to as "Member" or "Renter. " Effective Date: This contract shall become effective as of the date of signing. Purpose: The Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center is more than just a facility; it is a vibrant community hub that fosters connections, unity, and well-being among its members. We are dedicated to providing a safe, welcoming, and versatile space for various activities, ranging from fitness and recreation to community events and emergency shelter services. This contract outlines the terms and conditions of use to ensure a beneficial, enjoyable, and safe experience for all members and users of the Center. Membership Terms Membership Options Family Membership: Provides full access to the facility for family members on the same household account. The fee is $20 per month. Individual Membership: Provides full access to the facility for one person. The fee is $20 per month. Weight Room Only Membership: Provides access specifically to the weight room for a fee of $10 per month. Family Membership Definition A Family Membership covers members of a single household and is limited to two (2) adults, age 18 or older, plus minor children under 18 residing at the same primary address. Additional adults residing in the same household may be added to a Family Membership only with approval from RORC management and are subject to an additional $15 monthly fee per adult. RORC reserves the right to verify household residency and deny or revoke additional adult access if eligibility requirements are not met. No additional account users are currently listed, so this household/family membership section is informational unless users are added later. Fees and Payment Terms A one-time fee of $2 is required for a key card upon sign-up. Membership fees are due monthly and are non-refundable. Additional services, such as Wi-Fi, can be purchased for an extra $5 per month. Heat is billed at $13 an hour, billed monthly. Sign-up is required. Day Pass guest entry outside Open Gym is free for the first ten (10) Day Pass guest days per account per month. The same guest can be reused for 24 hours under the same account without using another free guest day. After ten free guest days, additional Day Pass guest days are billed at $0. 25 per guest day and billed monthly. Private Group Use Rental is available for $10 an hour.

pages.title: Start Membership | RORC
pages.text: Non-Private Group Use Rental is available for $5 an hour. Whole Day Rental is available. Prices vary. Payment and Delinquency Policy Membership fees are billed monthly and are due on the renewal date associated with the member's account. If payment is more than fourteen (14) days past due, the membership will be automatically canceled and all access privileges immediately revoked. This includes independent entry, Open Gym participation, guest entry, and signing in under another member. Access will not be restored until all outstanding balances are paid in full and a $20 reinstatement fee is applied. No refunds will be issued for cancellations due to nonpayment. Account and Contact Information Requirements All memberships require a valid and active email address and phone number on file at all times. Failure to maintain valid and active contact information renders the membership inactive and invalid. Inactive accounts may not access the facility or use any facility systems. Renewal and Cancellation Policy Memberships are automatically renewed each month. Members can cancel their membership at any time without penalty. Notice of cancellation shall be communicated to the Center's management to ensure proper processing. I have read and understand all terms in "Membership Terms. " Facility Access Availability and Exceptions While members generally have daily access, the facility may be unavailable during times when it is rented out for private events. Members are notified in advance of such events. The gym may also be closed occasionally for maintenance, or in instances where Wi-Fi is offline. Members will be informed of such closures as promptly as possible. Key Card Usage and Entry Most important: Every person must be signed in and out with each entry and exit, either as a Member, a registered Open Gym Member, or as a guest. If your account shows yellow there is an issue; if it shows red you are not allowed to enter. Each member is provided with a key card upon sign-up, allowing access to the facility. Members must swipe their own key card upon entry every time. There are no exceptions to this rule. The only exception to not swiping your own key is if you are a guest to another member. If a key card is lost or forgotten, members must contact the Center's management before entering the facility. Independent Access and Minor Policy Individuals aged 13 or older who intend to access the facility independently must complete their own individual contract and maintain an active membership in good standing. Children under the age of 13 may have a sign-in account for attendance tracking but must be accompanied by an adult at all times and may not access the facility independently.

Equipment Use and Cleanliness All gym equipment must be used in a safe and appropriate manner.

This requirement ensures the Center's ability to remain open and serve the public. I have read and understand all terms in "Liability and Insurance. " Privacy Policy Data Collection and Usage The Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center collects contact information and usage data from members for operational purposes, including membership management and event scheduling. Usage data includes monitoring attendance at Open Gym Nights and general facility use, which helps in planning and improving services. Data is managed through secure applications such as the RORC app, Supabase, Stripe, and other approved operational systems. Surveillance and Security Cameras The Center employs interior cameras as part of its smart home system, primarily for security and operational efficiency. Cameras are used to monitor gym usage, check if lights or the heating system are left on, and ensure overall security. The footage may be reviewed in case of incidents like lost items or other security concerns. All camera feeds are secured with robust security software, ensuring the privacy and protection of members. Protection of Personal Information The Center is committed to protecting the privacy and security of members' personal information. Measures are in place to prevent unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction of personal data.

" Termination of Membership Conditions for Termination Membership may be terminated for any breach of contract terms, including but not limited to failing to sign in and out, not wearing clean, appropriate gym shoes, and leaving doors open. Such violations are taken seriously and may result in immediate termination without prior warning. Members are expected to be thoroughly familiar with and adhere to all contract terms to maintain their membership status. Warning and Enforcement Process For minor or inadvertent infractions, the Center may issue a warning at its discretion. Repeated minor infractions or serious breaches, like leaving the facility unsecured, will result in automatic termination of membership. Open Gym Nights are considered locked events requiring mandatory sign-up and adherence to all facility rules. Membership Violation Policy and Reinstatement Terms By signing this contract, you acknowledge and agree to the following terms regarding membership violations and reinstatement: Membership Reinstatement and Fees: Depending on the nature and severity of the violation, your membership may be eligible for reinstatement with or without a delay, subject to a $20 reinstatement fee. Management reserves the sole discretion to determine whether reinstatement is permitted, whether a suspension period applies, or if the violation warrants permanent membership revocation. Automatic Termination: Certain violations, as outlined in the terms above, are considered serious infractions and may result in immediate and permanent termination of your membership without prior warning. No refunds will be issued in the event of a suspension or termination due to a violation. Notification of Suspension: If your membership is suspended or revoked, a statement outlining the violation and suspension terms will be sent to the phone number and email address on file. It is your responsibility to monitor and stay informed through the contact methods you have provided. Unauthorized Entry and Legal Consequences: Any attempt to enter the facility after receiving a violation notification may result in criminal charges, regardless of whether you have seen or acknowledged the message. By signing this contract, you accept full responsibility for staying up to date with all communications regarding your membership status. pages.title: Historic Gym Windows | RORC
pages.text: Historic Gym Windows | RORC RORC Login Menu Close Home About Memberships Rentals Sponsors Projects News & Updates Events Support Privacy Policy Terms of Service Historic Gym Windows Fundraiser Historic Gym Windows When the original windows were removed during recent upgrades, we chose not to discard them. These were the first windows installed in the Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center, looking out over decades of open gym nights, community gatherings, school events, and everyday life in Bly. We’re making them available to the community before anything else. Per window $25 Available 32 Pickup Local only The Details Sold individually Windows vary in condition Some original panes are available for restoration Local pickup only Windows are reserved only after online payment is completed. Why We’re Doing This Every dollar raised goes directly back into maintaining and improving the facility. This building has lasted because the community continues to invest in it. If you’ve ever used this gym, brought your kids here, attended an event, or simply want to own a physical piece of its story — this is an opportunity to do that. Purchase After purchase, we will contact you to coordinate pickup. Windows are sold one at a time to ensure fair availability. If you’re interested in purchasing multiple, please complete checkout separately or reach out to us and we’ll be happy to assist. pages.text: Privacy Policy | RORC RORC Login Menu Close Home About Memberships Rentals Sponsors Projects News & Updates Events Support Privacy Policy Terms of Service Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center Privacy Policy Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center Effective Date: February 22, 2026 Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center (“RORC,” “we,” “our,” or “us”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, how it is stored, and your rights regarding your information. 1. Information We Collect We may collect the following types of information: Personal Information Full name Email address Phone number and information you provide during a support call Mailing address Emergency contact information Date of birth (if required for membership) Membership Information Membership type and status Payment history Contract submissions WiFi subscription status Payment Information Payments are processed securely through Stripe. We do not store full credit card numbers on our servers. Stripe may collect payment details in accordance with its own privacy policy. Website & Technical Data IP address Browser type Device information Basic website usage analytics (via Google Analytics) 2. How We Use Your Information We use your information to: Process memberships and contracts Manage billing and subscriptions Send membership confirmations and updates Respond to customer support inquiries Provide WiFi access to subscribers Maintain facility security and operational records Comply with legal obligations We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. 3. How We Share Information We may share information with: Stripe for payment processing Technology service providers (such as website hosting or form platforms) Law enforcement if required by law All third-party providers are expected to maintain appropriate security measures. When you call the RORC phone line, speech may be processed by our telephony and AI service providers to operate the receptionist, answer general questions, and route an approved request to the RORC team. Please do not provide passwords, payment-card information, or other sensitive secrets by phone. 4. Data Storage & Security We take reasonable administrative and technical measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure. By using our services, you acknowledge this risk. 5. Data Retention We retain membership and payment records as long as necessary for: Active memberships Accounting and tax purposes Legal compliance You may request deletion of your personal data, subject to any legal or financial record-keeping requirements. 6.

pages.text: Your Rights You may: Request access to your personal information Request corrections to inaccurate information Request deletion of your data (when legally permissible) Withdraw consent for communications To make a request, contact us at: support@ruthobenchainrc. com 7. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised effective date. 9. pages.text: Terms of Service | RORC RORC Login Menu Close Home About Memberships Rentals Sponsors Projects News & Updates Events Support Privacy Policy Terms of Service Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center Terms of Service Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center Operated by Bly Community Action Team Effective Date: February 22, 2026 By accessing or using the Ruth Obenchain Recreation Center (“RORC,” “the Center,” “we,” or “us”), you agree to the following Terms of Service. 1. Agreement to Terms By purchasing a membership, signing a contract, entering the facility, or using any services provided by RORC, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to all terms outlined herein. This agreement applies to all members, open gym participants, renters, guests, and guardians of minors. 2. Membership Options & Fees Membership Types Family Membership – $20 per month Individual Membership – $20 per month Weight Room Only – $10 per month A $2 key card fee applies at sign-up. Memberships automatically renew monthly. Membership fees are non-refundable. 3. Family Membership Definition A Family Membership covers members of a single household and is limited to two (2) adults (age 18+) plus minor children (under 18) residing at the same primary address. Additional adults residing in the same household may be added to a Family Membership only with approval from RORC management and are subject to an additional $15 monthly fee per adult. RORC reserves the right to verify household residency and deny or revoke additional adult access if eligibility requirements are not met. 4. Payment & Delinquency Policy Membership fees are billed monthly and are due on the renewal date associated with the member’s account. If payment is more than fourteen (14) days past due, the membership will be automatically canceled and all access privileges immediately revoked. This includes independent entry, open gym participation, guest entry, and signing in under another member. Access will not be restored until all outstanding balances are paid in full and a $20 reinstatement fee is applied. No refunds will be issued for cancellations due to nonpayment. 5. Account & Contact Information Requirements All memberships require a valid and active email address and phone number on file at all times. Contact information must be unique to the individual account holder and may not be duplicated across independent accounts. Failure to maintain valid and active contact information renders the membership inactive and invalid. Inactive accounts may not access the facility or use any facility systems. 6.

pages.title: Terms of Service | RORC
pages.text: Additional Charges & Optional Services The following services may incur additional charges: WiFi Subscription – $5 per month Heater Use – $13 per hour (must be logged in system) Day Pass Guest Entry – first 10 guest days per account each month are free; the same guest can be reused for 24 hours under the same account, then $0. 25 per guest day after the free guest days (billed monthly) Open Gym Guests – free during Open Gym Private Rental – $10 per hour Non-Private Rental – $5 per hour Reinstatement Fee – $20 Improper heater use may result in a $50 penalty. A $5 fee will be associated with all incorrect use of group pay. All charges are automatically billed to the member’s account. 7. Facility Access & Key Card Use Every individual entering the facility must sign in and sign out. Each independent user must complete their own contract. Members must swipe their own key card upon entry. Unauthorized entry or misuse of access privileges may result in termination. Open Gym Nights Tuesday 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Family Open Gym) Thursday 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Adult Open Gym) The facility is generally open 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM, unless closed for maintenance or private events. 8. Independent Access & Minor Policy Individuals aged 13 or older who intend to access the facility independently must complete their own individual contract and maintain an active membership in good standing. Children under the age of 13 may have a sign-in account for attendance tracking but must be accompanied by an adult at all times and may not access the facility independently. Parents or guardians remain fully responsible for all minors associated with their membership. 9. Guest Policy Guests must be signed in under the member’s account. Day Pass guest fees are billed automatically at $0. 25 per guest day after the first 10 free guest days per account each month. A repeat Day Pass guest under the same account within 24 hours does not use another free guest day or add another fee. Guests may not be left unattended. Members are financially responsible for their guests. 10. Heating System Policy Heater use must be activated through the official application. The thermostat may not be manually adjusted. Improper use, unauthorized billing to another account, or tampering may result in: $50 penalty Membership suspension Immediate termination 11. Rules & Conduct Members agree to: Wear closed-toe, non-marking athletic shoes Clean equipment after use Return all equipment to its designated location Maintain cleanliness and sweep before leaving Respect other members Prohibited activities include: Climbing on structures Skateboards, bikes, rollerblades on gym floor Smoking or alcohol Leaving doors unsecured Misuse of facility equipment Failure to follow rules may result in suspension or termination. 12.

pages.text: Liability Waiver Use of the facility involves inherent risks. By using RORC facilities, you voluntarily assume all risks associated with participation. Parents or guardians assume full responsibility for minors. 13. Surveillance & Security The facility uses interior security cameras for safety, operational monitoring, and security. Footage may be reviewed in cases of: Security incidents Property damage Rule violations All systems are secured to protect member privacy. 14. Termination of Membership Membership may be terminated for: Breach of contract Failure to sign in/out Leaving facility unsecured Improper heater use Rule violations Serious violations may result in immediate termination without warning. No refunds are issued for terminated memberships. Reinstatement, if permitted, requires a $20 reinstatement fee and is at management discretion. Unauthorized entry after termination may result in legal action. 15. Private Events & Insurance Private event renters may be required to obtain insurance coverage naming Bly Community Action Team Inc. as additional insured with minimum coverage of $2,000,000 when applicable. 16. Communications & Policy Changes Members agree to receive communications via: Email Text message Website updates Application notifications It is the member’s responsibility to remain informed. RORC reserves the right to modify these Terms of Service at any time. Continued use of the facility constitutes acceptance of updated terms. 17.
